indicators.label: Religious affiliation %
indicators.description: Share of the municipality population reporting affiliation with a named religion (Islam, Orthodox, Catholic, or Others).
indicators.method: 100 * (population - No religious affiliation - Prefers not to answer) / population.
indicators.spatial_coverage: Kosovo municipalities (38 frame; 4 northern absent in 2011)
indicators.quality_notes: The six substantive categories are identical across waves (Islam, Orthodox, Catholic, Others, No religious affiliation, Prefers not to answer), preserved verbatim in Albanian, Serbian, and English. Affiliation is read as levels per wave, not as cross-wave change (northern coverage break). Percentages use each municipality's printed census population total. The Prefers- not-to-answer line stays in the denominator and outside both headline numerators, so the two shares need not sum to 100%.

indicators.label: No religious affiliation %
indicators.description: Share in the census No-religious-affiliation line (Asnjë besim fetar / Nema versku pripadnost).
indicators.method: 100 * (No religious affiliation line) / population. Prefers not to answer is not part of this slot.
indicators.spatial_coverage: Kosovo municipalities (38 frame; 4 northern absent in 2011)
indicators.quality_notes: The No-religious-affiliation and Prefers-not-to-answer lines grow sharply between waves (national 1,242 -> 7,899 and 9,708 -> 23,718); read as levels per wave, never as cross-wave change across the coverage break. Percentages use each municipality's printed census population total. The Prefers- not-to-answer line stays in the denominator and outside both headline numerators, so the two shares need not sum to 100%.
